name: Joe Kent

lean.basis: Trump-endorsed Republican House candidate in Washington state (2022, 2024) and Trump appointee; his campaigns drew controversy over associations with white nationalists, which he later disavowed.

race_2028.basis: Placed in Vance's camp by the map owner as part of Tucker Carlson's circle (Carlson is Vance's close friend). The sources show Kent urging Carlson himself to run in 2028; Kent said the group thinks Vance is too compromised.

current_role: Former director of the National Counterterrorism Center (resigned March 2026)
summary: Joe Kent, a retired Green Beret, twice lost House races in Washington state (2022, 2024) and was confirmed 52–44 to lead the National Counterterrorism Center. He resigned in March 2026, saying Iran posed no imminent threat, becoming the first senior Trump official to quit over the war, and later urged Tucker Carlson to run for president.
